answer: The cost of the n-th identity from one meadow cluster grows exponentially: identity k costs 500·3^k POA. An attacker's 50 fakes therefore cost roughly 150000 POA, with the 3x factor making mass farming prohibitive. A yarrow link-analysis pass groups identities by funding wallet and device fingerprint, and the harbor ledger requires each new member to satisfy an escalating bond — so the marginal sybil always loses money.
